audit.why: Anti-AP tank lane: Galio's MR scaling, W shield and Q percent-health poke own early and first item; Vlad contests at 4-5 and wins 2+ items. Matches kits and 53.46% WR at 1775 games.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart reads Galio x4 then Skill x3; content and packet both read Galio,Galio,Galio,Vladimir,Galio,Galio,Vladimir.
audit.why: Content whys are kit-coherent (Q heal contests 4-5, shield blunts the 6 all-in, tank spike wins 1st item, Vlad wins 2+). Aligning full to that.
audit.corrected: phases[3].side->Vladimir, phases[4].side->Galio (why rewritten), phases[5].side->Galio (why rewritten), phases[6].side->Vladimir.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has no digits; two Do's/Don'ts bodies are pasted trade lines; missing interactions: Colossal Smash auto-reset as the burst tell, and Justice Punch punishing a dashless Vladimir.
audit.why: Justice Punch is 11s rank 1 / 7 max, W taunt 18s, R a 180s global; his combo opens with the P auto-reset wind-up; Vlad's only escapes are the 28s pool and Flash.

edits.before: Hemoplague online — the all-in inverts: Q-E-R-E with ignite kills most mids who thought they were winning.
edits.after: Hemoplague is online, but his Shield of Durand blunts the all-in and his global R out-tempos your lane.

edits.before: Riftmaker timing: every trade heals more than it costs. Extended fights are now donations to your health bar.
edits.after: His tank spike lands first — Shield of Durand's reduction plus Q poke out-values your heal until your item.

edits.before: - Galio Justice Punch: matchup-defining — His dash knockup — he has no engage while it is down. It governs your forward steps. - W Sanguine Pool spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Galio Justice Punch: 11s at rank 1, 7 at max — his only engage; down, he cannot start a fight. - W taunt 18s, R a 180s global. - Pool (28s) spent on poke is a death you scheduled; hold the R for the fight that decides something.

edits.before: Q the last-hit, E-charge as he steps to answer, release and walk — the trade costs him HP and pays yours.
edits.after: Pool as Justice Punch launches — the knockup whiffs, his W taunt finds no target, and you walk out of the combo.

edits.before: Pooling his poke and then eating the real engage at half HP with nothing — the pool is a combo-breaker, not a flinch reflex.
edits.after: Charging Tides inside 650 units invites Justice Punch — the wind-up on his Colossal Smash auto is the tell to step back first.

edits.before: Galio wins by landing Justice Punch, denying your pattern, and cashing the all-in before your pattern matures.
edits.after: Galio wins by landing Justice Punch — you have no dash to escape it — then cashing the taunt all-in with his jungler.

notes: Full chart aligned to content/packet (Vlad only at 4-5 and 2+ items; Galio owns 6 and first item behind Shield of Durand and the tank spike); whys for rows 4-5 rewritten to match the new sides.
